note: Franklin County PA publishes no county-wide zoning layer; the county GIS portal (gisportal.franklincountypa.gov, Franklin_County_GIS_Map service) has no zoning layer. Municipal zoning (Chambersburg, Waynesboro, Shippensburg, Greencastle) is published as PDF maps and eCode360 text. The only ArcGIS zoning layer found, a personal Chambersburg copy (services9 .../Chambersburg_Zoning/FeatureServer/0), has 16 commercial-only polygons with the zone field empty for all features, so it fails validation (field-fill 0 of 16).
